sloka: यदि भर्तृहितार्थाय चरन्तं भर्तृशासनात् ।बध्नन्त्येते दुरात्मानो न तु मे निष्कृतिः कृता ।। 5.53.12।।।।
transliteration: yadi bhartṛhitārthāya carantaṁ bhartṛśāsanāt ।badhnantyete durātmāno na tu me niṣkṛtiḥ kṛtā ।। 5.53.12।।।।

translations.english: 'These evilminded demons bind me, ordered by their lord. When I am moving here for the welfare of my master, I will not let them escape৷৷
